The section title 'três vezes' becomes two losses plus one mis-searched artifact.
findings.proposed_en:
| frozen corpus of the interventional study (`action-archive-20260729T094609Z.tar.gz`) | `sha256`, path and mode `0400` declared | searched on 2026-08-30 by name, size and hash **on the serving machine only**, and reported missing. It is not: on 2026-10-03 it was at its declared path on the other host, with `sha256` equal to the pin (`ba5fcc81…`) and its 3,860-line manifest intact. The **280 adjudicated episodes** (`p2_verdict`, adjudicated 2026-08-15 → 08-21) were never in it (0 of 280 ids among its 5,547 episodes), and none of them survives in the live archive or in the trial lastro |

[replace l.1542-1547:] ⚠️ **The third case shows the cost in its pure form, though not in the way we first wrote it.** The panel adjudicated 280 episodes between 2026-08-15 and 08-21. The table kept `sig_primary`, `severity` and `chunk_id`, and the judged material is gone: 0 of the 280 ids appear in the frozen July corpus or in the trial lastro (checked 2026-10-03). What remains is **verdict without evidence**. The frozen corpus itself was never lost. Our search looked at one host and reported 'does not exist'; the file was at its declared path on the other host, byte-identical to the pin. That search was a guard whose predicate lacked the data, the same class this section catalogues.

[replace l.1557-1560:] A reviewer reading `CORPUS-FREEZE.md` sees a flawless document, and the file is where it says. Our own search still declared it missing, because it covered one host. **No reading distinguishes a valid pin from an orphaned one, and neither does a search scoped too narrowly; only retrieving the artifact does.**

findings.quote_pt: a intervenção correu em modo **shadow**: o contrafactual é observado, mas nada foi servido tratado. Toda taxa é **taxa de oportunidade**, não efeito.
findings.problem: STALE when read today: the separately registered trial served treated briefs from 2026-09-01 10:25:39Z to 2026-09-21 09:43:05Z (11 treatment epochs; w=2 was served active in 6 of them). §4.4 'a dose em vigor no shadow … nunca entregue a agente nenhum' and 'a dose em vigor no shadow reproduz a taxa' read as present-tense facts about the dose. The Abstract's 'o que o agente recebeu foi sempre o controle' has the same scope problem.
findings.proposed_en:
[§7] - in the window this paper measures (through 2026-08-31), the intervention ran in **shadow** mode: the counterfactual is observed and nothing treated was served, so every rate here is a **rate of opportunity**, not an effect. From 2026-09-01 10:25:39Z to 2026-09-21 09:43:05Z the separately registered trial did serve treated briefs (11 treatment epochs out of 19 with data). Its results are Paper B, not this paper.
[§4.4] The `w = 2` column is the dose configured for the shadow arm during the measured window: the treated composition under it, over these 350 historical states, was computed and logged and **never delivered to any agent**. (In the later trial, `w = 2` was served in six epochs. That is Paper B's data, not these 350 states.)
[§4.4 bullet] - the shadow dose of the measured window reproduces the published rate: `w = 2` gives **11/350 = 3.1429%**.
[Abstract] …and what the agent received during the measured window was always the control (§7).
findings.evidence: DEVIATIONS-FOR-PAPER.md §10.29 ('w=2 em 6 (09-04,05,08,09,16,19)'), §10.31(2) (8 control / 11 treatment, 0 divergences vs ASSIGNMENT-SERVING.json); MANUSCRIPT-B.md l.179-180; §10.1 table (shadow w=2 on 08-29..08-31).

doubts: L.1411-1583: o caminho `measurement/censo-de-alegacoes-sem-guarda.py` aparece duplicado na mesma citação (provável erro de digitação no PT); mantido idêntico na tradução.
A tabela de §6 fala em 'oito' defeitos e o catálogo diz 17 entradas; as 8 linhas da tabela conferem, mas o cabeçalho do §6.1 também usa 'oito' para 'os oito defeitos acima' em §6.2, consistente.

Em §6.1, `censo-de-universos-no-paragrafo.py` 'tem o `2,66` na sua tabela': mantive `2,66` literal por estar em code span (é o valor como grafado no script), então o token difere de 2.66 de propósito.
Em §7, 'quebra de regime em 21–22/08' convertido para '08-21–22' (ano omitido, não ISO completo) para manter o intervalo compacto; pode ser trocado por 2026-08-21–22.
Em §6.1, 'l. 428' (regra citada) mantido como 'l. 428': a numeração de linha do PT pode ter mudado e não tem equivalente no EN.
Em §6.1 'a frase dizia hoje... três semanas depois seria ~750 mil': 84,7 dias x ~7.500/dia não bate com ~750 mil de forma óbvia; traduzido sem alterar, apenas sinalizo.

Em §6.1, '1.787 / 67.187 = 2,66%' estava em code span, mas converti para notação inglesa (1,787 / 67,187 = 2.66%) por ser aritmética de prosa, não código; a mesma conversão em '1,635 / 67,187 = 2.43%'.
